+// Static report QA only; never contacts Clerk, API, database or providers.
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';
+const root = path.resolve('../..');
+const run = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.freebuff/auth-testing/current-run.txt'), 'utf8').trim();
+const browser = await chromium.launch();
+try {
+  const page = await browser.newPage();
+  const errors = []; page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
+  await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, 'docs/TESTING_REPORT.html')).href);
+  const auth = page.locator('#auth-live');
+  await auth.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+  assert.equal(await auth.locator(':scope > .table-wrap tbody tr').count(), 14);
+  assert.equal(await auth.locator(':scope > .table-wrap .badge.pass').count(), 8);
+  assert.equal(await auth.locator(':scope > .table-wrap .badge.skip').count(), 6);
+  assert.ok(await auth.innerText().then(t => t.includes('No product defect was confirmed')));
+  const details = auth.locator('details').last(); await details.locator('summary').click();
+  const evidence = JSON.parse(await details.locator('pre').innerText());
+  assert.equal(evidence.renewal.sameSession, true);
+  assert.equal(evidence.renewal.expiredTokenStatus, 401);
+  assert.equal(evidence.recovery.oldSessionStatus, 'removed');
+  assert.ok(Object.values(evidence.database.preexistingUnchanged).every(Boolean));
+  assert.equal(evidence.spending.paidProviderRequests, 0);
+  await details.locator('summary').click();
+  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(run, 'auth-report-desktop.png') });
+  await page.locator('#file-search').fill('AuthenticationPage.ts');
+  assert.equal(await page.locator('.file-card:visible').count(), 1);
+  await page.locator('#file-search').fill('');
+  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 412, height: 915 });
+  await auth.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
+  await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(run, 'auth-report-mobile.png') });
+  assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1));
+  assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
+  const result = { authScenarioRows: 14, passed: 8, blocked: 6, evidenceVerified: true,
+    sourceSearch: true, mobileOverflow: false, pageErrors: errors };
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(run, 'auth-report-check.json'), JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
+  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
+} finally { await browser.close(); }
apps/web/e2e/scripts/live-server-evidence.mjsNew · +29 / −0

Check real-server public/authentication boundaries without displaying redirect URLs, bodies or authentication headers.

SHA-256: 248f68e44db7c391da641859072bf559569347ecbedcd1350cd3ab3d376dfb86

--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/e2e/scripts/live-server-evidence.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+// Public boundaries only: never prints redirect URLs, response bodies or headers.
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+const checks = [];
+for (const [service, base, endpoint, init] of [
+  ['api', 'http://localhost:4000', '/health/ready', {}],
+  ['api', 'http://localhost:4000', '/trpc/projects.list', {}],
+  ['api', 'http://localhost:4000', '/ai/stream', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' }],
+  ['web', 'http://localhost:3000', '/dashboard', {}],
+  ['web', 'http://localhost:3000', '/dashboard', { headers: { 'x-playwright': '1' } }],
+]) {
+  const check = { service, endpoint, spoofedTestHeader: !!init.headers?.['x-playwright'], status: null };
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch(base + endpoint, { ...init, redirect: 'manual', signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000) });
+    check.status = response.status;
+    await response.body?.cancel();
+  } catch (error) {
+    check.errorType = error.name;
+    check.errorCode = error.cause?.code ?? null;
+  }
+  checks.push(check);
+  if (process.argv[2]) fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), checks }, null, 2));
+  console.log(JSON.stringify(check));
+}
+const evidence = { at: new Date().toISOString(), checks };
+if (process.argv[2]) fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2));
+console.log(JSON.stringify(evidence));
+if (checks[0].status !== 200 || checks[1].status !== 401 || checks[2].status !== 401 || checks.slice(3).some(c => ![302, 303, 307, 308, 401, 403, 404].includes(c.status))) {
+  throw new Error('Real service boundary preflight failed');
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/e2e/scripts/smoke-production.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
+import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
+import { createServer } from 'node:net';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { readdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+async function checkProductionChunks(directory) {
+  for (const entry of await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+    const file = path.join(directory, entry.name);
+    if (entry.isDirectory()) await checkProductionChunks(file);
+    else if (entry.name.endsWith('.js')) assert.doesNotMatch(await readFile(file, 'utf8'), /e2e-mocked-session|Mock sign-in boundary/, `Mock identity must not ship in ${file}`);
+  }
+}
+await checkProductionChunks('.next/static/chunks');
+
+const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
+const listener = createServer();
+await new Promise(resolve => listener.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
+const port = listener.address().port;
+await new Promise(resolve => listener.close(resolve));
+// No real account, database or provider requests. PLAYWRIGHT=1 deliberately
+// probes that production refuses the development mock-auth switch.
+// Keep the request and listening hostname identical: Clerk rewrites public
+// requests internally, and mixed loopback hostnames trigger an external proxy.
+const child = spawn(process.execPath, [require.resolve('next/dist/bin/next'), 'start', '--hostname', 'localhost', '--port', String(port)], {
+  env: { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'production', PLAYWRIGHT: '1', NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: 'pk_test_ZXhhbXBsZS5jbGVyay5hY2NvdW50cy5kZXYk', CLERK_SECRET_KEY: 'sk_test_isolated_smoke_placeholder' },
+  stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], windowsHide: true,
+});
+let output = '';
+try {
+  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`Web startup timed out: ${output}`)), 60_000);
+    child.stdout.on('data', chunk => {
+      output += chunk;
+      if (/Ready in/.test(output)) { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); }
+    });

apps/web/e2e/scripts/warmup.tsNew · +12 / −0

Compile development routes before feature assertions to avoid cold-start timeouts.

SHA-256: c31512eeec19020d763a98a7ded267def1104ad6689af3c17dd9764884797f9f

--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/e2e/scripts/warmup.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+import type { FullConfig } from '@playwright/test';
+
+export default async function warmup(config: FullConfig) {
+  const base = config.projects[0].use.baseURL!;
+  // Compile each development route before measuring browser assertions. This
+  // keeps cold Next.js compilation out of feature timeouts on slower machines.
+  for (const path of ['/', '/dashboard', '/templates', '/docs', '/settings', '/sign-in', '/project/00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000001/interview']) {
+    const response = await fetch(base + path, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120_000) });
+    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`E2E warmup failed: ${path} (${response.status})`);
+    await response.text();
+  }
+}

+test('live SaaS: all ten domains, skip/revisit, rewind, choices and saved completion', async ({ page }, info) => {
+  test.setTimeout(20 * 60_000);
+  const allowance = Number(process.env.E2E_PROVIDER_SPEND_USD);
+  test.skip(!(allowance > 0), 'Requires explicit live spending authorization');
+  expect(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT).toBe('0');
+  expect(process.env.ENABLE_AI_TRIAGE).toBe('false');
+  expect(process.env.E2E_PROVIDER).toBe('metamuse');
+  const recordPath = process.env.E2E_RUN_RECORD;
+  test.skip(!recordPath, 'Full interviews require a durable E2E_RUN_RECORD and spending ledger');
+  const record = fs.existsSync(recordPath!) ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(recordPath!, 'utf8')) : { checkpoints: [] };

+  const settings = new SettingsPage(page, info);
+  await settings.gotoSettings();
+  await settings.selectActiveProvider('metamuse');
+  if (!record.projectId) {
+    const dashboard = new DashboardPage(page, info);
+    await dashboard.gotoDashboard();
+    record.name = `E2E Full SaaS ${Date.now()}`;
+    record.projectId = await dashboard.createProject(record.name, 'saas');
+    saveRecord();
+    await interview.submitDiscovery({ teamSize: 'small', timeline: '1_3_months', budget: 'bootstrapped', experience: 'intermediate' });
+    await interview.expectPlanningOpener();
+  } else {
+    await interview.gotoInterview(record.projectId);
+  }
+  const projectId = record.projectId as string;

+  // Natural provider failures are retained, checked against the real database,
+  // and retried at most twice. No simulated response is installed in this lane.
+  async function settle(expectedCount: number, domainId: string, priorDocument?: string) {
+    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
+      await expect.poll(async () => {
+        if (await retry.isVisible()) return 'error';
+        const pct = await page.getByRole('progressbar').filter({ visible: true }).getAttribute('aria-valuenow');
+        return pct === String(expectedCount * 10) && await input.isEnabled() ? 'ready' : 'busy';
+      }, { timeout: 70_000, intervals: [500, 1000] }).not.toBe('busy');
+      if (!(await retry.isVisible())) break;
+      const evidence = await captureLiveEvidence(projectId, `${domainId}-failure-${attempt}`, info);
+      // The document generation must not advance progress when it failed.
+      if (evidence.project.interview_data.completedDomains.length < expectedCount) {
+        expect(evidence.project.status).not.toBe('complete');
+        expect(evidence.project.interview_data.completedDomains).not.toContain(domainId);
+        expect(evidence.documents.find(d => d.domain_id === domainId)?.content).toBe(priorDocument);
+      }
+      if (attempt === 2) throw new Error(`Provider failed after bounded retries in ${domainId}`);
+      await retry.click();
+    }
+    await expect.poll(() => readLiveEvidence(projectId).project.interview_data.completedDomains.length,
+      { timeout: 45_000, intervals: [1000, 2000] }).toBe(expectedCount);
+    await expect(input).toBeEnabled();
+  }
+  async function checkpoint(name: string, count: number) {
+    const before = await captureLiveEvidence(projectId, name, info);
+    await page.screenshot({ path: info.outputPath(`${name}.png`) });
+    await page.reload({ waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+    await expect(page.getByRole('progressbar').filter({ visible: true })).toHaveAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(count * 10), { timeout: 45_000 });
+    await expect(input).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 45_000 });
+    const after = readLiveEvidence(projectId);
+    expect(after.project.interview_data.completedDomains).toEqual(before.project.interview_data.completedDomains);
+    expect(after.project.interview_data.lockedChoices).toEqual(before.project.interview_data.lockedChoices);
+    // Compare every saved conversational turn through the actual rendered UI.
+    for (const message of before.project.interview_data.conversationHistory) {
+      if (message.role === 'user') await expect(page.getByText(message.content, { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true }).last()).toBeVisible();
+    }
+    record.checkpoints.push({ name, count, at: new Date().toISOString() }); saveRecord();
+  }
+  let completed = readLiveEvidence(projectId).project.interview_data?.completedDomains ?? [];
+  if (!completed.includes('planning')) {
+    await interview.answerOpenQuestion('A habit tracker for remote teams: workspace admins invite teammates, users create habits, check in daily, view streaks and export their history. Tenant isolation and accessible mobile screens are required.');
+    await settle(1, 'planning');
+  }
+  if (!record.rewindVerified) {
+    completed = readLiveEvidence(projectId).project.interview_data.completedDomains;
+    if (!completed.includes('architecture')) {
+      await button(/Skip for now/).click();
+      await settle(2, 'architecture');
+    }
+    await checkpoint('skip-saved-reloaded', 2);
+    expect(readLiveEvidence(projectId).documents.find(d => d.domain_id === 'architecture')?.content).toContain('Deferred to v2');
+    await button('Revisit Architecture').click();
+    await expect.poll(() => readLiveEvidence(projectId).project.interview_data.completedDomains, { timeout: 45_000 }).toEqual(['planning']);
+    await checkpoint('rewind-saved-reloaded', 1);
+    expect(readLiveEvidence(projectId).project.interview_data.conversationHistory.some(m => m.domainId === 'database')).toBe(false);
+    record.rewindVerified = true; saveRecord();
+  }
+  const cards: Record<string, string> = { database: 'Managed PostgreSQL', environment: 'Local + Staging + Prod', auth: 'Clerk', testing: 'Vitest + Playwright', deployment: 'Vercel' };
+  const answers: Record<string, string> = {
+    api: 'Workspace admins invite teammates. Members create, list, update and archive habits, create daily check-ins, view streak summaries and export their own history. Require tenant ownership, idempotent check-ins, pagination and consistent error responses.',
+    frontend: 'Login, workspace selection, responsive dashboard with habit list and streak summary, habit detail with calendar and daily check-in, member invitation screen, and settings with data export. Include keyboard navigation and loading, empty and failure states.',
+  };
+  for (const domain of domains.slice(1)) {
+    completed = readLiveEvidence(projectId).project.interview_data.completedDomains;
+    if (completed.includes(domain.id)) continue;
+    await expect(input).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 45_000 });
+    const prior = readLiveEvidence(projectId).documents.find(d => d.domain_id === domain.id)?.content;
+    if (domain.id === 'architecture' || domain.id === 'monitoring') {
+      await button('I need a custom option').click();
+      await page.getByPlaceholder('Describe your custom choice...').filter({ visible: true }).fill(domain.id === 'architecture' ? 'Modular monolith with tenant boundaries' : 'Sentry with structured logs and metrics');
+      await button('Confirm').click();
+    } else if (domain.mode === 'open') await interview.answerOpenQuestion(answers[domain.id]);
+    else await interview.pickCard(cards[domain.id]);
+    const count = domains.findIndex(d => d.id === domain.id) + 1;
+    await settle(count, domain.id, prior);
+    if ([3, 6, 10].includes(count)) await checkpoint(`checkpoint-${count}-domains`, count);
+  }
+  const final = await captureLiveEvidence(projectId, 'full-completion-database', info);
+  expect(final.project.status).toBe('complete');
+  expect(final.project.interview_data.completedDomains).toEqual(domains.map(d => d.id));
+  expect(final.documents.map(d => d.domain_id).sort()).toEqual(domains.map(d => d.id).sort());
+  for (const document of final.documents) {
+    expect(document.content.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(100);
+    expect(document.content).not.toContain('Deferred to v2');
+  }
+  await page.screenshot({ path: info.outputPath('live-interview.png') });
+  await info.attach('provider-budget', { body: JSON.stringify(spending()), contentType: 'application/json' });
+  await flushNetworkMonitor(page, info);
+  expect(getContractViolations(page)).toEqual([]);
+  expect(getFailedRequests(page)).toEqual([]);
+  expect(getConsoleErrors(page)).toEqual([]);
+  record.complete = true; saveRecord();
+});

+import fs from 'node:fs';

+for (const mobile of [false, true]) {
+  test.describe(mobile ? 'mobile emulation' : 'desktop', () => {
+    // A describe may override context options, but not worker browser type.
+    const { defaultBrowserType: _browserType, ...mobileContext } = devices['Pixel 7'];
+    if (mobile) test.use(mobileContext);
+    test('live library: search, domain filters, deep links and preview navigation', async ({ page }, info) => {
+      test.setTimeout(8 * 60_000);
+      test.skip(!process.env.E2E_RUN_RECORD, 'Complete and edit a full live interview first');
+      expect(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT).toBe('0');
+      const run = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.E2E_RUN_RECORD!, 'utf8'));
+      const evidence = readLiveEvidence(run.projectId);
+      expect(evidence.project.status).toBe('complete');
+      const domains = getActiveDomains('saas');
+      await page.goto('/docs', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+      const search = page.getByPlaceholder('Search documents...');
+      await expect(search).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });
+      await search.fill(run.name);
+      await expect(page.getByText('10 documents', { exact: true })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });
+      await search.fill(`missing-${run.name}`);
+      await expect(page.getByText('No documents match your search or filter.')).toBeVisible();
+      await search.fill(run.name);
+      const docButton = (file: string) => page.getByRole('button').filter({ hasText: file }).filter({ hasText: run.name }).filter({ visible: true }).first();
+      for (const domain of domains) {
+        await docButton(domain.file).click();
+        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: `Live revision ${domain.id}`, exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toBeVisible();
+        if (mobile) await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close', exact: true }).filter({ visible: true }).click();
+      }
+      if (!mobile) {
+        for (const domain of domains) {
+          await page.locator('aside').getByRole('button').filter({ hasText: domain.label }).click();
+          await expect(page.getByText('1 document', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
+          await expect(docButton(domain.file)).toBeVisible();
+        }
+      }
+      for (const domain of [domains[2], domains[9]]) {
+        await page.goto(`/docs?domain=${domain.id}`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
+        await page.getByPlaceholder('Search documents...').fill(run.name);
+        await expect(page.getByText('1 document', { exact: true })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });
+        await docButton(domain.file).click();
+        await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: `Live revision ${domain.id}`, exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toBeVisible();
+        const [file] = await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent('download'), page.getByRole('button', { name: /Download/ }).filter({ visible: true }).click()]);
+        expect(file.suggestedFilename()).toBe(domain.file);
+        const output = info.outputPath(`${mobile ? 'mobile' : 'desktop'}-${domain.file}`);
+        await file.saveAs(output);
+        expect(fs.readFileSync(output, 'utf8')).toBe(evidence.documents.find(d => d.domain_id === domain.id)!.content);
+        await page.screenshot({ path: info.outputPath(`library-${domain.id}.png`) });
+        if (mobile) await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close', exact: true }).filter({ visible: true }).click();

+// Targeted real Clerk/API/PostgreSQL coverage. Authentication is never mocked.
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import type { BrowserContext, Page, TestInfo } from '@playwright/test';
+import { test, expect } from '../lib/fixtures';
+import { AuthenticationPage } from '../lib/pages/AuthenticationPage';
+import { attachNetworkMonitor, flushNetworkMonitor } from '../lib/monitoring/networkMonitor';
+import { attachConsoleMonitor } from '../lib/monitoring/consoleMonitor';
+
+const run = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve('../../.freebuff/auth-testing/current-run.txt'), 'utf8').trim();
+const accountFile = path.join(run, 'accounts.json');
+const original = path.resolve('e2e/storage-state/user.json');
+const originalHash = createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(original)).digest('hex');
+const saved = path.join(run, 'saved-original-copy.json');
+if (!fs.existsSync(saved)) fs.copyFileSync(original, saved);
+type Account = { clerkId: string; localId: string; createdAt: number; projectId?: string; name?: string; body?: string; sessionId?: string };
+type Accounts = { startedAt: string; A?: Account; B?: Account };
+if (!fs.existsSync(accountFile)) fs.writeFileSync(accountFile, JSON.stringify({ startedAt: new Date().toISOString() }));
+const accounts = (): Accounts => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(accountFile, 'utf8'));
+const store = (record: Accounts) => fs.writeFileSync(accountFile, JSON.stringify(record, null, 2));
+const state = (label: string) => path.join(run, `account-${label}.json`);
+function evidence(mode: string, value?: string): any {
+  return JSON.parse(execFileSync(process.execPath, [path.resolve('../api/scripts/auth-test-evidence.mjs'), mode, ...(value ? [value] : [])],
+    { encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, timeout: 60_000 }));
+}
+function record(name: string, value: unknown) {
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(run, `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(value, null, 2));
+}
+let paidAttempts = 0;
+test.beforeEach(async ({ context }) => {
+  await context.route('**/*', async route => {
+    const url = new URL(route.request().url());
+    if ((url.port === '4000' && (url.pathname.startsWith('/ai/') || /keys\.upsert/.test(url.pathname)))) {
+      paidAttempts++;
+      record('provider-guard', { paidRequestsForwarded: 0, blockedAttempts: paidAttempts });
+      await route.abort('blockedbyclient');
+      throw new Error('Auth-only test attempted a forbidden provider operation');
+    }
+    await route.continue();
+  });
+});
+test.afterEach(async () => {
+  expect(createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(original)).digest('hex'), 'Original storage state preserved').toBe(originalHash);
+  record('provider-guard', { paidRequestsForwarded: 0, blockedAttempts: paidAttempts });
+});
+async function token(page: Page) {
+  await page.waitForFunction(() => !!(window as any).Clerk?.loaded && !!(window as any).Clerk?.session, null, { timeout: 60_000 });
+  return page.evaluate(async () => await (window as any).Clerk.session?.getToken({ skipCache: true }) ?? null);
+}
+function claims(jwt: string) {
+  const data = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(jwt.split('.')[1], 'base64url').toString());
+  return { iat: data.iat as number, exp: data.exp as number, sid: data.sid as string };
+}
+async function rpc(page: Page, info: TestInfo, procedure: string, input?: unknown, mutation = false, explicitToken?: string | null) {
+  const auth = explicitToken === undefined ? await token(page) : explicitToken;
+  const response = await fetch('http://localhost:4000/trpc/' + procedure + (!mutation && input !== undefined ? '?input=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(input)) : ''), {
+    method: mutation ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', ...(auth ? { authorization: `Bearer ${auth}` } : {}) },
+    ...(mutation ? { body: JSON.stringify(input) } : {}), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000),
+  });
+  const body = await response.json() as any;
+  const item = { at: new Date().toISOString(), procedure, method: mutation ? 'POST' : 'GET', status: response.status,
+    code: body.error?.data?.code ?? null, requestId: response.headers.get('x-request-id') };
+  fs.mkdirSync(info.outputDir, { recursive: true });
+  fs.appendFileSync(info.outputPath('api-statuses.jsonl'), JSON.stringify(item) + '\n');
+  return { status: response.status, data: body.result?.data, code: item.code };
+}
+async function shot(page: Page, info: TestInfo, name: string) {
+  const file = info.outputPath(name + '.png');
+  await page.screenshot({ path: file, fullPage: false });
+  await info.attach(name, { path: file, contentType: 'image/png' });
+}
+async function loadAccount(page: Page, label: 'A' | 'B', info: TestInfo) {
+  test.skip(!fs.existsSync(state(label)), `Disposable account ${label} signup is required`);
+  await page.context().addCookies(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(state(label), 'utf8')).cookies);
+  await new AuthenticationPage(page, info).dashboard();
+  expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as any).Clerk.user.id)).toBe(accounts()[label]!.clerkId);
+}
+function requireBoth() { test.skip(!accounts().A?.projectId || !accounts().B?.projectId, 'Both disposable fixtures are required'); }
+
+test('01 saved session restoration and genuine token expiry/renewal', async ({ browser, page }, info) => {
+  await page.context().addCookies(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(saved, 'utf8')).cookies);
+  const auth = new AuthenticationPage(page, info);
+  await auth.dashboard();
+  expect((await rpc(page, info, 'projects.list')).status).toBe(200);
+  await page.reload();
+  await auth.dashboard();
+  await auth.goto('/settings');
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Account menu' })).toBeVisible();
+  const first = await token(page);
+  expect(first).toBeTruthy();
+  const before = claims(first!);
+  const session = evidence('session', before.sid);
+  record('session-lifetime', { tokenIssuedAt: before.iat, tokenExpiresAt: before.exp, tokenLifetimeSeconds: before.exp - before.iat,
+    clerkSession: session, distinction: 'JWT expiration is separate from the Clerk session expireAt/abandonAt' });
+  const waitMs = Math.max(0, before.exp * 1000 - Date.now() + 7_000);
+  test.skip(waitMs > 150_000, 'Natural token lifetime exceeds bounded renewal wait');
+  await page.waitForTimeout(waitMs);
+  const expired = await rpc(page, info, 'projects.list', undefined, false, first);
+  const second = await token(page);
+  expect(second).toBeTruthy();
+  const after = claims(second!);
+  const renewed = await rpc(page, info, 'projects.list', undefined, false, second);
+  record('renewal', { before: { iat: before.iat, exp: before.exp }, after: { iat: after.iat, exp: after.exp },
+    sameSession: before.sid === after.sid, differentToken: first !== second, expiredTokenStatus: expired.status,
+    renewedTokenStatus: renewed.status, wallClockWaitMs: waitMs });
+  expect(expired.status).toBe(401);
+  expect(after.exp).toBeGreaterThan(before.exp);
+  expect(after.sid).toBe(before.sid);
+  expect(renewed.status).toBe(200);
+  const context = await browser.newContext({ storageState: saved, recordVideo: { dir: info.outputDir } });
+  try {
+    const restored = await context.newPage();
+    attachNetworkMonitor(restored, info); attachConsoleMonitor(restored, info);
+    await new AuthenticationPage(restored, info).dashboard();
+    expect((await rpc(restored, info, 'projects.list')).status).toBe(200);
+    await shot(restored, info, 'restored-dashboard');
+    await flushNetworkMonitor(restored, info);
+  } finally { await context.close(); }
+});
+
+for (const label of ['A', 'B'] as const) test(`02 signup dedicated disposable account ${label} and persist non-AI fixtures`, async ({ page }, info) => {
+  const auth = new AuthenticationPage(page, info);
+  if (fs.existsSync(state(label))) await loadAccount(page, label, info);
+  else await auth.humanAuth(label, true);

+  expect(identity.localId).toBeTruthy();

+    expect((await rpc(page, info, 'documents.update', { projectId, domainId: 'planning', content: body }, true)).status).toBe(200);
+    const session = await rpc(page, info, 'sessions.create', { projectId, metadata: { projectType: 'saas', activeDomains: ['planning'],
+      teamSize: 'solo', timeline: '1_3_months', budget: 'bootstrapped', experienceLevel: 'intermediate' } }, true);
+    expect(session.status).toBe(200);
+    recordData[label]!.sessionId = session.data.id; store(recordData);
+    expect((await rpc(page, info, 'sessions.logMessage', { sessionId: session.data.id, role: 'user', content: `AUTH TEST ${label} telemetry`, domainId: 'planning',

+
+test('03 reciprocal ownership API and UI isolation with unchanged database records', async ({ browser, page }, info) => {

+    try {

+        ['projects.get', { id: victim.projectId }, false],
+        ['documents.listByProject', { projectId: victim.projectId }, false],

+        ['projects.update', { id: victim.projectId, data: { interviewData: { elaboration: 'FORBIDDEN EDIT' } } }, true],
+        ['documents.update', { projectId: victim.projectId, domainId: 'planning', content: 'FORBIDDEN DOCUMENT EDIT' }, true],

+test('04 real UI sign-out protects second tab, reload, deep link and Back; reauthentication', async ({ page, context }, info) => {
+  requireBoth(); await loadAccount(page, 'A', info);

+  await new AuthenticationPage(other, info).dashboard();

+    try { await new AuthenticationPage(tab, info).expectPrivateAbsent([project.name]); outcomes[label] = true; }

+  await page.goBack(); await auth.expectPrivateAbsent([project.name]); outcomes.back = true;

+test('05 genuine Clerk revocation rejects current token, expires naturally and permits reauthentication', async ({ page }, info) => {

apps/web/lib/interview/snapshot.tsNew · +43 / −0

Validate stored interview fields independently and recover safely from malformed legacy data.

SHA-256: 9adcaa71d42982faef0d15481f3c849ebf7633b4e0b99b20ee5cff574f3a00d6

--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/web/lib/interview/snapshot.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import { DomainIdSchema, ProjectContextSchema } from '@devdocs/shared';
+import type { ChatMessage, DomainId, ProjectContext } from '../types';
+
+export interface SavedInterviewData {
+  lockedContext: ProjectContext;
+  lockedChoices: Partial<Record<DomainId, Record<string, string>>>;
+  completedDomains: DomainId[];
+  domainContent: Partial<Record<DomainId, string>>;
+  conversationHistory: ChatMessage[];
+  elaboration: string;
+}
+const record = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
+
+/** Old clients stored loosely typed JSON. Recover valid fields individually. */
+export function readSavedInterviewData(value: unknown): SavedInterviewData | null {
+  if (!record(value)) return null;
+  const context = ProjectContextSchema.safeParse(value.lockedContext);
+  if (!context.success) return null;
+  const content: SavedInterviewData['domainContent'] = {};
+  const choices: SavedInterviewData['lockedChoices'] = {};
+  for (const [id, body] of Object.entries(record(value.domainContent) ? value.domainContent : {})) {
+    const domain = DomainIdSchema.safeParse(id);
+    if (domain.success && typeof body === 'string') content[domain.data] = body;
+  }
+  for (const [id, choice] of Object.entries(record(value.lockedChoices) ? value.lockedChoices : {})) {
+    const domain = DomainIdSchema.safeParse(id);
+    if (domain.success && record(choice)) choices[domain.data] = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(choice).filter((entry): entry is [string, string] => typeof entry[1] === 'string'));
+  }
+  const completed = (Array.isArray(value.completedDomains) ? value.completedDomains : []).flatMap(id => {
+    const domain = DomainIdSchema.safeParse(id); return domain.success ? [domain.data] : [];
+  });
+  const messages: ChatMessage[] = (Array.isArray(value.conversationHistory) ? value.conversationHistory : []).flatMap(message => {
+    if (!record(message) || !['user', 'assistant'].includes(String(message.role)) || typeof message.content !== 'string') return [];
+    const clean: ChatMessage = { role: message.role as ChatMessage['role'], content: message.content };
+    for (const field of ['showCards', 'domainId'] as const) {
+      const domain = DomainIdSchema.safeParse(message[field]); if (domain.success) clean[field] = domain.data;
+    }
+    if (typeof message.isComplete === 'boolean') clean.isComplete = message.isComplete;
+    if (typeof message.showDownload === 'boolean') clean.showDownload = message.showDownload;
+    return [clean];
+  });
+  return { lockedContext: context.data, lockedChoices: choices, completedDomains: [...new Set(completed)], domainContent: content, conversationHistory: messages, elaboration: typeof value.elaboration === 'string' ? value.elaboration : '' };
+}

docs/TESTING_REPORT.mdNew · +761 / −0

Record coverage, defects fixed, verified results, reproduction commands and outstanding release checks.

SHA-256: 1020eac161f5caeceba8b66dee852c793683c00db7a68081b6d1a48c66831a8c

--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/TESTING_REPORT.md
@@ -0,0 +1,761 @@
+# Targeted real Clerk authentication — 2026-10-01
+
+Real Clerk, the running production frontend/API and configured application
+PostgreSQL were used. **Session restoration, natural JWT expiry/renewal,
+sign-out boundaries and same-account reauthentication passed.** Full session
+expiry, explicit backend revocation, reciprocal ownership isolation and
+dedicated-account deletion are blocked, not simulated passes.
+
+| Scenario | Actual result | Evidence / limitation |
+|---|---|---|
+| Saved authentication, dashboard reload and fresh browser-context restoration | **PASSED** | saved-session-rerun/results.json; original state SHA-256 assertion |
+| Natural short-lived JWT expiration rejects protected API access | **PASSED** | 60-second JWT; 63,331 ms wall-clock wait; original token API 401 |
+| Genuine token renewal within the same active Clerk session | **PASSED** | Later iat/exp, changed JWT, unchanged session; renewed token API 200 |
+| Full Clerk session expiration / inactivity expiration | **BLOCKED** | Session expiry is days away; not shortened, time-shifted or simulated |
+| Explicit supported backend session revocation; rejection before JWT expiry | **BLOCKED** | No dedicated disposable account available; existing session was not administratively revoked |
+| Real UI sign-out and already-open second-tab private-data clearing | **PASSED** | Both tabs cleared private project data; signout assertions persisted before HITL timeout |
+| Unauthenticated protected API requests after sign-out | **PASSED** | projects.list and documents.list returned 401 |
+| Reload, project deep link, browser Back and second-tab reload after sign-out | **PASSED** | Private data absent throughout; deep link reached public sign-in, final HTTP 200 |
+| Recoverable sign-in, same-account reauthentication and protected access | **PASSED** | Recovery rerun passed: old session removed, different session, API 200 and reload; separate refreshed state |
+| A-to-B and B-to-A UI/API read, list, edit, export, rename and delete isolation | **BLOCKED** | CAPTCHA loop; operator chose existing-account sign-in; safety guard rejected existing identity |
+| Database invariance after denied cross-account mutations | **BLOCKED** | No two-account fixture exists; no cross-account mutations attempted |
+| Dedicated disposable account deletion UI and database cascade | **BLOCKED** | No account created specifically for deletion; no existing account or application data deleted |
+| Deletion authentication/session behavior and other-account preservation | **BLOCKED** | Deletion not attempted; source implements local-data deletion followed by Clerk profile, not identity deletion |
+| Preservation of every preexisting application database row | **PASSED** | All six table row IDs/hashes unchanged; original counts unchanged |
+
+The observed JWT lifetime was **60 seconds**. After a **63,331 ms natural wait**,
+the retained expired JWT received HTTP 401; a genuine newly minted JWT received
+HTTP 200 with later issuance/expiry timestamps and the **same Clerk session**.
+Dashboard reload, protected Settings and a fresh browser context using copied
+saved state passed. No clocks, tokens, ownership responses or database access
+were mocked or modified. Clerk distinguishes its short JWT lifetime from its
+longer session lifetime in [its session model](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/how-clerk-works/overview).
+Full session expiration/inactivity expiration was not exercised: those configured
+deadlines were days away. UI sign-out subsequently changed the original session
+to **removed**, and human sign-in created a **different session for the same user**.
+Protected project API access and reload passed after recovery. This is sign-out
+and reauthentication evidence, not explicit `sessions.revokeSession` coverage.
+
+Signup in bundled Chromium encountered an operator-reported Cloudflare CAPTCHA
+refresh loop. Installed Chrome was tried with normal CAPTCHA protections intact;
+the operator chose sign-in instead. The safety guard proved that the signed-in
+identity predated this run and rejected it as a disposable fixture. No disposable
+A/B account, project, document or telemetry record was created. The four
+dedicated-account-dependent Playwright cases were explicitly skipped for missing
+fixtures. Read/list/edit/export/rename/delete isolation in both directions and
+unchanged records after denied mutations therefore remain **unverified**.
+Cloudflare documents that automated browsers can be unsupported by its challenges;
+this is a possible explanation, not a proven cause of this specific loop.
+[Cloudflare browser support](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-challenges/reference/supported-browsers/).
+
+Deletion source review confirmed that `account.deleteData` deletes the local
+`users` row and relies on foreign-key cascades for projects, documents, keys,
+sessions and messages. The actual Privacy UI requires `DELETE`, calls that
+endpoint, then opens Clerk account management to complete identity deletion.
+The endpoint does **not** delete the Clerk identity or revoke its sessions.
+Authenticated requests can auto-provision a fresh empty local user while the
+identity remains active. These are implementation findings, **not live deletion
+or cascade evidence**. No deletion endpoint or UI was exercised because no account
+was created specifically for deletion; the existing account was preserved.
+
+All preexisting database rows retained their IDs and whole-row hashes in all six
+tables: **1 user, 35 projects, 66 documents, 1 provider key, 36 sessions and 163
+messages**. The completed project `c75d5a6b-fdb8-4ffe-89dc-1209e1864221` remains
+intact. No accounts or application records were deleted. Existing artifacts and
+reports were copied into the new archive before writes. The original
+`e2e/storage-state/user.json` is unchanged; it refers to the now removed original
+session. Usable refreshed authentication is retained separately as
+`saved-reauthenticated.json` in this run's archive. Original and refreshed state,
+raw traces and videos are sensitive local artifacts and are not embedded in HTML.
+
+No confirmed product defect was found and no product implementation changed.
+The first restoration attempt requested a token before Clerk had loaded after
+navigation; adding a readiness wait fixed that harness failure and the focused
+rerun passed. The saved sign-out runner passed all recorded boundary assertions
+but timed out during the human recovery pause after a long elapsed interval.
+The first recovery attempt required a sign-in form even though human sign-in
+had already restored access; accepting the authenticated state corrected that
+selector expectation. The final standalone recovery rerun passed and established
+the changed session, same identity, HTTP 200 and reload. These retained failures
+are harness/interaction/environment outcomes, not product failures. Automatic
+triage is heuristic; the classifications in this report use the actual evidence.
+
+Runner executions are retained separately: **1 passed** saved-session rerun;
+**1 passed** final recovery rerun; **4 skipped** disposable-dependent cases.
+The saved sign-out runner failed at the HITL timeout despite its persisted passing
+boundary assertions; the earlier renewal and recovery failures and interrupted
+signup attempts are preserved. This is not a single all-passing live suite.
+Web typecheck, frontend lint, helper syntax and `git diff --check` passed. The
+standalone HTML opened at desktop/mobile sizes, verified all 14 auth rows
+(8 passed / 6 blocked), renewal/recovery/database evidence and source search,
+with no page errors or mobile overflow. QA screenshots and final check logs are
+retained in the archive. Since
+there was no product change, no fresh build, unit/integration run or full
+deterministic browser rerun was needed. Earlier **141 deterministic passes / 1
+skip, 73 unit passes, 25 disposable PostgreSQL integration passes and zero audit
+findings** remain prior results, not expanded real-auth coverage.
+
+Final listeners and process commands confirm the usable production real-auth
+frontend on **3000, PID 10776**, and API on **4000, PID 8036**. No server was
+replaced or stopped, and `.next` was not rebuilt while browser tests ran.
+Final readiness returned 200; unauthenticated project/AI boundaries returned 401;
+protected frontend requests returned 404 with and without the spoofed test header.
+Authenticated project requests returned 200 in the final recovery test.
+`PLAYWRIGHT=0` and `ENABLE_AI_TRIAGE=false` were retained.
+
+**Zero paid provider requests, zero provider-key verification requests, and zero
+AI triage requests.** Unauthenticated AI boundary probes returned 401 before any
+provider call. Spending guards blocked no attempted paid operation. No commit or
+deployment occurred. The truncating integration suite was not run, database
+guards were unchanged, and application `DATABASE_URL` was not replaced.
+
+Artifact archive: `.freebuff/auth-testing/20261001-200010/`. It contains copied
+historical artifacts/reports, original and separate refreshed state, timestamped
+runner directories, screenshots, traces, videos, sanitized API-status JSONL,
+Clerk lifetime/renewal/sign-out/recovery evidence, database baseline/final hashes,
+server boundary/process evidence and `final-verification-summary.json`.
+`test-results/auth-runs.json` points to this summary; regenerated HTML keeps all
+historical results separate and includes the actual auth scenario/attempt ledger.
+
+The remaining work requires two disposable accounts created for testing,
+including one specifically for deletion, plus a practical way to exercise real
+session expiration. Backend revocation must use supported Clerk mechanisms; no
+revocation, expiration, ownership or deletion result should be inferred from
+deterministic coverage or source review.
+
+---
+
+# Testing and fixes — consolidated deterministic execution 2026-10-01
+
+## PostgreSQL integration and production audit refresh — 2026-10-01
+
+**25 integration tests passed across 5 files in 113.67 seconds**, with zero
+failures. This is a fresh execution on real, disposable Supabase PostgreSQL
+through the Session pooler, not the configured application database. Read-only
+preflight verified `current_database() = devdocs_e2e_test`, an empty public
+schema before migrations, and a different application host/database name.
+The existing `_test` name guard stayed enabled. The suite applied committed
+migrations, created test rows and truncated only this verified test target.
+Post-run read-only checks found the six expected application tables and zero
+rows in all six. The test schema is retained for future integration runs.
+
+| Integration file | Passed | What was exercised |
+|---|---:|---|
+| projects.test.ts | 11 | Project lifecycle, ownership and validation |
+| documents.test.ts | 2 | Document backfill, editing and ownership |
+| sessions.test.ts | 2 | Interview-session persistence and ownership |
+| account.test.ts | 2 | Owned-data export and account cascade deletion |
+| keys.test.ts | 8 | Encryption, masking, rotation and preservation on provider errors |
+
+The database is real; provider verification responses in key tests remain
+doubles. These results do not expand real Clerk, paid provider or browser
+coverage. `ENABLE_AI_TRIAGE=false`; no paid requests or provider-key
+verification occurred. Application `DATABASE_URL`, existing live projects,
+browser storage and earlier artifacts were preserved. Only the test URL's
+host/path were corrected during setup, with private environment backups kept
+in the ignored archive and no secrets displayed.
+
+The direct endpoint was unreachable on this machine's IPv4 connection. After
+the user selected the Session pooler, its URL still selected `postgres`; the
+guard rejected it before SQL. The path was corrected to `devdocs_e2e_test`.
+An initial pnpm command rejected `--outputFile` before starting tests; the
+corrected command used `run test`. A cleanup helper initially misquoted a
+qualified table identifier (PostgreSQL `42P01`); correcting that helper made
+the read-only check pass. These were configuration/harness issues, not product
+defects. Hook/test timeouts were bounded at 120/30 seconds for remote latency;
+test assertions, retry behavior and the database guard were unchanged.
+
+The fresh production audit found one **low** DOMPurify advisory in
+`posthog-js@1.404.1 > dompurify@3.4.13`, with zero moderate/high/critical
+findings. The root override now selects **DOMPurify 3.4.16**, the patched
+version for [GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p).
+Only that override and its lockfile dependency references/integrity changed;
+other dependency versions and existing uncommitted changes were preserved.
+The post-fix `pnpm audit --prod --json` exited 0 with **zero findings across
+442 production dependencies**. The advisory's special in-place sanitation
+hook conditions were not reproduced in this app; this is a dependency fix,
+not evidence of a confirmed application exploit.
+
+Compatibility checks passed: forced typecheck (3 tasks), forced lint (1 task),
+fresh real-auth web production build, isolated API/web production smoke and
+portable HTML report verification on desktop/mobile. The report checks verify
+the consolidated 142 browser rows, the new 25 integration passes, the zero-finding
+audit, search, embedded screenshots and absence of mobile overflow/page errors.
+The sandbox initially could not resolve Turbo; the same commands passed with
+approved escalation. No application failure was confirmed.
+
+The fresh real-auth production frontend is running on **3000, PID 10776**,
+with **PLAYWRIGHT=0** and AI triage disabled. The original API remains on
+**4000, PID 8036**. Final public boundary checks passed: API readiness 200,
+unauthenticated project/AI endpoints 401, and frontend dashboard requests
+rejected with and without a spoofed test header. No authenticated live workflow
+was rerun. The previous frontend build was archived before replacement.
+
+The first final boundary attempt failed its assertion without retaining statuses;
+the next timed out without identifying the request. The monitoring helper now
+retains sanitized per-request statuses/errors, including partial failures, and
+cancels unused response bodies. The final check passed with the same statuses
+as the earlier accepted server check (200/401/401/404/404). The cause of the
+initial failures was not established; no product defect was confirmed.
+
+The earlier consolidated deterministic
+result remains **141 passed / 1 intentional skip**, run before this dependency
+patch; the full browser suite was not rerun for this transitive dependency update.
+The earlier real SaaS interview, document/export and library results remain
+historical live coverage. Spending reservations remain **$4.96119375 cumulative**,
+with **$0 newly reserved** for this refresh; exact provider billing is unverified.
+
+Artifacts, before/after reports, dependency baselines, sanitized preflight and
+cleanup evidence, both audit results and runner JSON are retained under
+`.freebuff/integration-testing/20261001-152103/`. Historical root integration
+and audit JSON files remain unchanged. No commit or deployment occurred.
+
+Reproduce from the repository root after separately verifying a disposable
+`TEST_DATABASE_URL`:
+
+```powershell
+node apps/api/scripts/verify-test-database.mjs
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/api run test --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=<new-artifact-path> --hookTimeout=120000 --testTimeout=30000
+pnpm audit --prod --json
+```
+
+## Earlier consolidated browser acceptance — one complete execution
+
+The browser continuation code passed one complete execution of
+`pnpm --filter @devdocs/web test:e2e`: **142 discovered cases, 141 passed,
+1 intentional skip, 0 failed, 0 flaky, 0 retry attempts and 0 runner errors**.
+Playwright exited 0 and reported **43.3 minutes**; its JSON duration is
+**2,600,208.689 ms (43 minutes 20.209 seconds)**, including setup and teardown.
+The execution started at `2026-10-01T08:58:29.704Z`.
+
+| Browser project | Passed | Intentional skips | Failed |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|
+| Desktop Chromium | 70 | 1 | 0 |
+| Pixel 7 emulation | 71 | 0 | 0 |
+| Consolidated total | 141 | 1 | 0 |
+
+The desktop skip is `mobile sheets are hidden until opened and support Escape`,
+annotated `Mobile sheet interaction`. Its mobile execution passed. Retries
+remained disabled; the passing result is a single runner execution, rather
+than a union of focused reruns.

+and provider streams are mocked by the existing framework. These passes do not

+## Scope
+
+The existing Playwright framework now runs deterministic feature and failure
+tests on desktop Chromium and Pixel 7 emulation. It retains the framework's
+page objects, network/console logs, failure classification, videos, traces,
+screenshots, and agent feedback. The live Clerk/provider lane remains separate.
+
+| Area | Automated checks |
+|---|---|
+| Projects | All six types, required fields, create failure/retry, rename, delete, ownership, soft deletion, progress denominators |
+| First use | Anthropic/OpenAI/Meta Muse verification, invalid keys, verification outage/retry, configured Bedrock |
+| Interviews | All active domains for every project type, custom choices, skip, rewind, reload, keyboard selection, per-project provider, history |
+| Recovery | Auth/rate-limit/network/persistence errors, malformed/empty/incomplete SSE, retry without duplicate messages, snapshot retries, malformed stored data |
+| Documents | Canonical persistence, per-domain editing, failed-save drafts, horizontal rules/Unicode, regeneration, search, deep links, Markdown and parsed ZIP downloads |
+| Settings/account | Key storage/removal/rotation, provider selection, Bedrock status, export without raw key material, account-data deletion confirmation/failure |
+| UI | Desktop/mobile layouts, horizontal overflow, visible controls, mobile dialogs/focus/Escape, search keyboard handling, screenshot artifacts |
+| Security boundaries | AES-GCM tamper detection, ownership, unauthorized API requests, Markdown XSS payloads, production dependency audit |
+| API/operations | Compiled server startup, health, metrics, retired REST route, authenticated tRPC/SSE boundaries, migrations, sessions |
+
+These are feature and boundary checks. They do not constitute measured 100%
+statement/branch coverage or proof that production cannot fail.
+

+  sheet test. No unexpected console errors were found across the artifacts.
+- Isolated API/provider/browser-stream suite: **62 passed**, including the

+- PostgreSQL integration suite: **25 passed** using a newly initialized local
+  PostgreSQL 15.18 cluster, committed migrations, and a database named
+  `devdocs_e2e_test`. Provider verification was mocked; database writes and
+  encryption were real. The temporary server was stopped afterward.
+- Compiled API smoke: **passed**.
+- Production dependency audit: **0 findings** across the 441 dependencies
+  reported by `pnpm audit --prod`.
+- Typecheck: **all three packages passed**. Frontend lint: **passed**.
+- Agent failure digest: **no failed tests**. `git diff --check`: **passed**.
+- Web production build: **passed**. Production authentication smoke: **passed**:
+  homepage/security headers, unauthenticated protected routes, spoofed test and
+  middleware headers, and absence of mock identity in shipped browser chunks.

+Earlier browser runs found test-selector ambiguity after the Next upgrade and
+when a mobile document dialog covered the chat download button. The selectors
+were corrected. They also exposed a real homepage overflow defect, which was
+fixed with responsive navigation and content grids.
+
+The production smoke initially failed because the harness mixed `127.0.0.1`
+and `localhost`, causing Clerk's internal rewrite to become a proxy request.
+Using the same listening and request hostname resolved the harness failure.
+
+## Product defects fixed
+
+1. AI chat openers and clarification replies could overwrite saved documents.
+   Only explicit generation requests now persist documents, and completion
+   waits for persistence.
+2. Empty or truncated provider replies could be marked complete. They now
+   produce recoverable errors. Cancellation clears the stream timeout and
+   stops the provider request.
+3. Retrying a failed generation lost its completion action. Retry now preserves
+   the original action and avoids duplicating the user's chat message.
+4. Skipped domains were local-only. Deferred documentation now saves before
+   progress advances, with a retry path on failure.
+5. Editing merged Markdown by splitting horizontal rules could mix domain
+   content. Editing now saves each domain explicitly, retains failed drafts,
+   and disables export while changes are unsaved.
+6. Failed project hydration could leave an indefinite skeleton. Load errors
+   now display a retry action; malformed saved interview fields are validated.
+7. Several mutations lacked visible failure handling. Project/template errors
+   now show feedback, and retrying template initialization reuses its project.
+8. Mobile layouts, action-menu positioning, hidden sheet focus, key-input
+   masking, document/settings deep links, and search edge cases were corrected.
+9. A request header could enable the web authentication bypass. Mock identity
+   now requires an explicit development test server; production uses Clerk.
+10. The compiled API could not start because of unresolved module imports.
+    It now builds a runnable Node bundle, checked by a startup smoke test.
+11. The rate-limit counter and expiry were separate operations. A single Redis
+    script now updates both and repairs keys with no expiry.
+12. Vulnerable production dependencies were updated, including Next 15.5.24,
+    React 19 compatibility, Hono, Drizzle, and affected transitive packages.
+13. Long generated replies could exceed the API's 4,000-character history limit
+    on the next request. Only the recent context sent to the provider is now
+    bounded; stored messages and exported documents remain intact.
+
+The Next upgrade addresses published advisories, including the
+[Windows server advisory](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories/GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36).
+
+## Reproduce
+
+```sh
+pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+pnpm typecheck
+pnpm lint
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/api test:unit
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/api test       # requires disposable TEST_DATABASE_URL
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/api build
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/api test:smoke
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/web exec playwright install chromium
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/web test:e2e
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/web report:agent
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/web build
+pnpm --filter @devdocs/web test:smoke
+pnpm audit --prod
+```
+
+Run the browser development server and production build sequentially: they
+share `.next`. CI provides its own PostgreSQL 15 service. Never weaken the test
+database-name guard: integration setup migrates and truncates its target.
+
+## Historical remaining validation — superseded where stated above
+
+- Basic real Clerk login and authenticated database-backed dashboard access now
+  pass (see the live section). Full session expiry/account management, other
+  providers, and complete real-service interviews remain outside verified scope.
+  The September 27 run did not modify the configured remote database; the
+  September 30 run applied existing migrations and authorized live test activity.
+- Redis Lua behavior is tested with a client double; a real Upstash outage and
+  concurrent traffic exercise has not been performed.
+- Safari/WebKit, Firefox, physical mobile devices, assistive technologies,
+  formal contrast/accessibility audits, and visual baseline comparisons have
+  not been certified by this run. Screenshots are review artifacts.
+- Load/soak tests, deployment infrastructure, backup/restore, monitoring
+  delivery, and provider output quality remain separate release checks.
+- Deploy web and API together: new generation calls explicitly send
+  `persistDocument: true`; older callers omit this flag.
+
+Local artifacts are under `apps/web/playwright-report`, `apps/web/test-results`,
+and root `test-results`. They are ignored by Git. CI uploads browser artifacts.

+section += '''
+The observed JWT lifetime was **60 seconds**. After a **63,331 ms natural wait**,
+the retained expired JWT received HTTP 401; a genuine newly minted JWT received

+Dashboard reload, protected Settings and a fresh browser context using copied

+Full session expiration/inactivity expiration was not exercised: those configured

+
+Deletion source review confirmed that `account.deleteData` deletes the local

+sessions and messages. The actual Privacy UI requires `DELETE`, calls that

+The endpoint does **not** delete the Clerk identity or revoke its sessions.
+Authenticated requests can auto-provision a fresh empty local user while the

+

+
+No confirmed product defect was found and no product implementation changed.
+The first restoration attempt requested a token before Clerk had loaded after
+navigation; adding a readiness wait fixed that harness failure and the focused
+rerun passed. The saved sign-out runner passed all recorded boundary assertions
+but timed out during the human recovery pause after a long elapsed interval.
+The first recovery attempt required a sign-in form even though human sign-in
+had already restored access; accepting the authenticated state corrected that
+selector expectation. The final standalone recovery rerun passed and established
+the changed session, same identity, HTTP 200 and reload. These retained failures
+are harness/interaction/environment outcomes, not product failures. Automatic
+triage is heuristic; the classifications in this report use the actual evidence.
+
+Runner executions are retained separately: **1 passed** saved-session rerun;
+**1 passed** final recovery rerun; **4 skipped** disposable-dependent cases.
+The saved sign-out runner failed at the HITL timeout despite its persisted passing
+boundary assertions; the earlier renewal and recovery failures and interrupted
+signup attempts are preserved. This is not a single all-passing live suite.
+Web typecheck, frontend lint, helper syntax and `git diff --check` passed. Since

+deterministic browser rerun was needed. Earlier **141 deterministic passes / 1
+skip, 73 unit passes, 25 disposable PostgreSQL integration passes and zero audit
+findings** remain prior results, not expanded real-auth coverage.
+
+Final listeners and process commands confirm the usable production real-auth
+frontend on **3000, PID 10776**, and API on **4000, PID 8036**. No server was
+replaced or stopped, and `.next` was not rebuilt while browser tests ran.
+Final readiness returned 200; unauthenticated project/AI boundaries returned 401;

+deployment occurred. The truncating integration suite was not run, database

+++ b/scripts/generate_testing_report.py
@@ -0,0 +1,495 @@
+"""Build a portable, offline report from this run's results and working-tree diff.
+
+Run from any directory: python scripts/generate_testing_report.py
+No packages, network access, or credentials required. Does not run application tests.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from collections import Counter
+import base64
+import difflib
+import hashlib
+import html
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUTPUT = ROOT / 'docs/TESTING_REPORT.html'
+GENERATOR = Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
+
+
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, check=True, capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
+
+
+def read(file):
+    data = (ROOT / file).read_bytes()
+    return data.decode('utf-16' if data.startswith((b'\xff\xfe', b'\xfe\xff')) else 'utf-8-sig')
+
+
+def esc(value):
+    return html.escape(str(value), quote=True)
+
+
+def json_file(file):
+    return json.loads(read(file))
+
+
+def relative(file):
+    return str(file).replace(str(ROOT).replace('\\', '/') + '/', '').replace(str(ROOT) + '\\', '').replace('\\', '/')
+
+
+def badge(status):
+    color = 'pass' if status == 'passed' else 'skip' if status in ('skipped', 'pending', 'blocked', 'interrupted') else 'fail'
+    return f'<span class="badge {color}">{esc(status)}</span>'
+
+
+def pretty_json(data):
+    return esc(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+def inline(text):
+    text = esc(text)
+    text = re.sub(r'`([^`]+)`', r'<code>\1</code>', text)
+    text = re.sub(r'\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', r'<strong>\1</strong>', text)
+    return re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\((https://[^)]+)\)', r'<a href="\2">\1</a>', text)
+
+
+def markdown(text):
+    """Small renderer for the committed report's headings, tables, lists and code."""
+    blocks, paragraph, listing, table, code = [], [], [], [], None
+
+    def flush():
+        if paragraph:
+            blocks.append('<p>' + inline(' '.join(paragraph)) + '</p>')
+            paragraph.clear()
+        if listing:
+            blocks.append('<ul>' + ''.join('<li>' + inline(item) + '</li>' for item in listing) + '</ul>')
+            listing.clear()
+        if table:
+            rows = [r for r in table if not re.match(r'^\|[- :|]+\|$', r)]
+            blocks.append('<div class="table-wrap"><table>' + ''.join('<tr>' + ''.join(f'<{"th" if i == 0 else "td"}>{inline(c.strip())}</{"th" if i == 0 else "td"}>' for c in row.strip('|').split('|')) + '</tr>' for i, row in enumerate(rows)) + '</table></div>')
+            table.clear()
+
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith('```'):
+            if code is None:
+                flush()
+                code = []
+            else:
+                blocks.append('<pre>' + esc('\n'.join(code)) + '</pre>')
+                code = None
+        elif code is not None:
+            code.append(line)
+        elif line.startswith('#'):
+            flush()
+            level = min(len(line) - len(line.lstrip('#')) + 1, 4)
+            blocks.append(f'<h{level}>' + inline(line.lstrip('# ')) + f'</h{level}>')
+        elif not line.strip():
+            flush()
+        elif line.startswith('|'):
+            table.append(line)
+        elif re.match(r'^(?:- |\d+\. )', line):
+            listing.append(re.sub(r'^(?:- |\d+\. )', '', line))
+        elif listing and line.startswith(' '):
+            listing[-1] += ' ' + line.strip()
+        else:
+            paragraph.append(line.strip())
+    flush()
+    return ''.join(blocks)
+
+
+# Human-readable explanations accompany the complete, unabridged diff appendix.
+DESCRIPTIONS = {
+    'packages/shared/src/types.ts': 'Share the 4,000-token Meta Muse completion budget between the real provider adapter and live test spending guard.',
+    '.github/workflows/ci.yml': 'Run database and isolated unit suites, desktop/mobile deterministic E2E, upload artifacts, and smoke-test production API/web builds.',
+    'CLAUDE.md': 'Update architecture, Next/React versions, testing lanes, document persistence invariants, and agent working guidance.',
+    'README.md': 'Document current architecture, testing commands, save behavior, and link the run report.',
+    'apps/api/package.json': 'Use a runnable bundled API entry point; add unit/smoke scripts and upgrade vulnerable dependencies/build tooling.',
+    'apps/api/build.mjs': 'Bundle the API as Node CommonJS using esbuild; include shared workspace source and externalize third-party packages.',
+    'apps/api/scripts/smoke-build.mjs': 'Start the actual compiled API with isolated configuration and check health, metrics, authentication and retired REST routes.',
+    'apps/api/src/lib/aiStream.ts': 'Validate provider completion reasons for Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI and Meta Muse; reject truncated or filtered responses.',
+    'apps/api/src/lib/crypto.ts': 'Require exactly 64 hexadecimal encryption-key characters and safely mask short provider keys.',
+    'apps/api/src/lib/rateLimit.ts': 'Atomically increment Redis counters and set/repair expiry using Lua; preserve fail-open behavior on Redis errors.',
+    'apps/api/src/routes/hono/ai.ts': 'Validate JSON and legacy context, reject empty output, explicitly opt into document persistence, save before completion, and handle cancellation safely.',
+    'apps/api/src/routes/projects.test.ts': 'Replace obsolete REST tests with real PostgreSQL tRPC project lifecycle, ownership and validation checks.',
+    'apps/api/vitest.config.ts': 'Exclude isolated unit files from the database integration lane.',
+    'apps/api/vitest.unit.config.ts': 'Add an isolated Node unit lane that does not load destructive database setup.',
+    'apps/web/app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx': 'Surface mutation errors; implement rename validation; avoid false download success.',
+    'apps/web/app/(app)/docs/page.tsx': 'Support domain deep links, mobile document navigation and responsive layout.',
+    'apps/web/app/(app)/project/[id]/interview/page.tsx': 'Validate hydration snapshots, expose retry for load failure, and use Next 15-compatible route parameters.',
+    'apps/web/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx': 'Honor settings deep links and adapt sidebar/content layout to mobile widths.',
+    'apps/web/app/(app)/templates/page.tsx': 'Show initialization failures and reuse the created project when retrying a partially failed template operation.',
+    'apps/web/app/landing.module.css': 'Add responsive navigation/content grids/footer; contain the roadmap badge within its pricing card.',
+    'apps/web/components/dashboard/CreateProjectModal.tsx': 'Mask provider-key entry and add an accessible label with autocomplete disabled.',
+    'apps/web/components/dashboard/DashboardSidebar.tsx': 'Constrain and scroll mobile sidebar content.',
+    'apps/web/components/dashboard/ProjectCard.tsx': 'Compute progress from applicable domains and keep the actions menu inside the viewport.',
+    'apps/web/components/docs/DocList.tsx': 'Adapt document navigation sizing for mobile.',

+                status = last.get('status', 'not run')
+                evidence = []
+                for attempt, result in enumerate(results):
+                    for attachment in result.get('attachments', []):
+                        if attachment['contentType'] != 'application/json':
+                            continue
+                        if attachment.get('path'):
+                            file = Path(attachment['path'])
+                            if browser_artifacts != ROOT / 'apps/web/test-results':
+                                try:
+                                    file = browser_artifacts / file.relative_to(ROOT / 'apps/web/test-results')

+                                    pass

+                            data = base64.b64decode(attachment['body']).decode('utf-8')
+                        else:
+                            continue
+                        try:
+                            data = json.dumps(json.loads(data), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+                        except ValueError:
+                            pass
+                        evidence.append(f'<details><summary>{esc(attachment["name"])} · attempt {attempt + 1}</summary><pre>{esc(data)}</pre></details>')

+        walk(suite.get('suites', []), (*parents, suite['title']))

+"""Resolve deterministic outcomes across the complete run and focused reruns."""
+import json
+from collections import Counter
+from pathlib import Path
+
+root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+manifest = json.loads((root / 'test-results/refresh-runs.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
+latest = {}
+
+def walk(suites, run):
+    for suite in suites:
+        for spec in suite.get('specs', []):
+            for test in spec.get('tests', []):
+                attempts = test.get('results', [])
+                if not attempts:
+                    continue
+                file = spec.get('file', suite.get('file', '')).replace('\\', '/')
+                key = (file, spec['title'], test.get('projectName', ''))
+                latest[key] = dict(file=file, title=spec['title'], project=key[2],
+                                   status=attempts[-1]['status'], latestRun=run)
+        walk(suite.get('suites', []), run)
+
+for run in manifest['runs']:
+    report = json.loads((root / run['report']).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
+    if 'stats' in report:
+        walk(report.get('suites', []), run['name'])
+
+summary = dict(scope='Deterministic doubles only; desktop Chromium and Pixel 7 emulation',
+               uniqueCases=len(latest), finalStatuses=dict(Counter(row['status'] for row in latest.values())),
+               cases=list(latest.values()))
+output = root / 'test-results/deterministic-resolution.json'
+output.write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
+print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in summary.items() if key != 'cases'}))
